name: Xfinity Mobile Arena (formerly Wells Fargo Center)
about: The Flyers' and 76ers' arena (1996), 3601 S. Broad St.: an oval-plan bowl under a white barrel roof whose edge the venue calls the 'eyebrow', wrapped in lower white, glass and tan-masonry blocks. No source publishes its height or plan, so the roof's size, axis, eave and crown are measured on the 2022 LiDAR: the roof runs flat along its long axis and curves across its width. The 2024 corner LED boards and the 2025 Xfinity logo are dated facade details.

footprint.note: L&I footprint objectid 60294 (3601 S BROAD ST, 'Wells Fargo Center'); OSM way 25312366 is the same building.

ground_navd88_m.note: Measured: median classified-ground return in a 3-15 m ring around L&I 60294 (scripts/50_landmark_measure.py, output/landmarks/measure/xfinity_mobile_arena.json).

roof_top_height_m.note: Measured: 99th percentile of the roof cells (the region above 70% of the outline's 99th-percentile height, flood-filled from the top) (scripts/50_landmark_measure.py, output/landmarks/measure/xfinity_mobile_arena.json).

eave_height_m.note: Measured: 2nd percentile of the roof cells in the 3 m band along the roof rectangle's edge. The cross-section's end bins read 31.03 and 30.84 m; the lower figure follows the rounded corners down (scripts/50_landmark_measure.py, output/landmarks/measure/xfinity_mobile_arena.json).

roof_length_m.note: Measured: long side of the roof's minimum rotated rectangle (scripts/50_landmark_measure.py, output/landmarks/measure/xfinity_mobile_arena.json).

roof_width_m.note: Measured: short side of the same rectangle (scripts/50_landmark_measure.py, output/landmarks/measure/xfinity_mobile_arena.json).

roof_center.note: Measured: center of the roof rectangle (scripts/50_landmark_measure.py, output/landmarks/measure/xfinity_mobile_arena.json).

roof_cross_section_m.unit: m above ground per 2 m across the roof
roof_cross_section_m.note: Measured: maximum LiDAR height per bin within 3 m of the short axis (scripts/50_landmark_measure.py, output/landmarks/measure/xfinity_mobile_arena.json, bowl.profiles.short). Along the long axis the roof is flat at about the crown height.

led_board_height_m.note: Published as 35 ft. Three exterior LED boards 'just under 35 feet in height' at the northeast and northwest corners and on the south facade (2023 release; lit April 8, 2024).

roof.note: White roof from above: median of the lit pixels (darkest 25% dropped) inside li 60294 in the 2024 aerial (scripts/50_landmark_measure.py, output/landmarks/measure/xfinity_mobile_arena.json).

roof_side.note: Roof seen from the side, evening light: median of the box (pixels x0, y0, x1, y1), darkest 25% dropped. Reference photo, a modeling reference only.

masonry_block.note: Tan masonry block on the west side, warmed by low sun; render it cooler: median of the box (pixels x0, y0, x1, y1), darkest 25% dropped. Reference photo, a modeling reference only.

white_facade.note: White curved facade panels, in shade: median of the box (pixels x0, y0, x1, y1), darkest 25% dropped. Reference photo, a modeling reference only.

glass.note: Glass band: median of the box (pixels x0, y0, x1, y1), darkest 25% dropped. Reference photo, a modeling reference only.

logo.reason: FOX 29 (Aug. 14, 2025, https://www.fox29.com/news/xfinity-mobile-arena-new-signage-added-facade-former-wells-fargo-center) describes the new facade logo as purple; no color value published, so this purple is our pick.

roof.form: barrel: flat along the long axis, curved across the width (LiDAR cross-section)
roof.edge: the 'Brow' (https://www.acclaimlighting.com/blogs/projects/xfinity-mobile-arena): a lit band along the roof edge

kit_params.base: lower blocks inside the L&I outline outside the roof rectangle stay as LiDAR parts
kit_params.windows: glass bands and entries as detail paint; no window grid on the roof volume

credits: LiDAR: City of Philadelphia 2022 classified LiDAR via PASDA (https://www.pasda.psu.edu/uci/DataSummary.aspx?dataset=7154)
Footprints: City of Philadelphia L&I building footprints (OpenDataPhilly)

open_questions: No published height or plan dimensions; everything structural is measured.
The reference photo predates the 2024 LED boards and the 2025 Xfinity logo.
